intent: Build a relevant keyword list from an image
brief: A ceramic mug beside an open notebook at a kitchen table. Separate visible objects, setting and supported concepts. No assumptions about remote work.

intent: Review Adobe Stock automatic keywords and reorder the first ten
brief: A cyclist crossing a wooden bridge. Remove an incorrect city and race label; show a ten-term priority sequence and explain omissions.

intent: Find missing Adobe Stock keywords without copying competitors
brief: A macro of a dew-covered leaf. Subject-detail-composition audit; distinguish moss from a leaf and only use botanical species if verified.

intent: Generate stock keywords locally with AI and review the result
brief: Start to finish on one photo of fresh bread; explicit download, one thread, observe preview, review hallucinated ingredients, export.

intent: Adapt one metadata draft for Adobe Stock and Shutterstock
brief: A potter shaping a clay bowl. Explain English draft, title style, priority and per-platform review, with two worked metadata variants.

intent: Export stock metadata CSV and verify filename matching
brief: Three assets with .jpg and .mov extensions, one case mismatch and one renamed file. Show a safe reconciliation procedure.

intent: Batch keywording for a mixed professional shoot
brief: A 24-file shoot with portraits, workspace details and empty interiors. Group by actual subject; shared factual context without blanket tags.

intent: Plan free local keywording time and optional API costs
brief: A hypothetical 120-file batch. Give a worksheet using measured local sample time, no invented speed or price claims, optional API bill checking.

intent: Compare local AI, paid API and manual keywording fairly
brief: A repeatable small test set of six different image types; score factual errors and editing time instead of unverified model league tables.

intent: Choose a stock keywording tool using a practical checklist
brief: Feature requirements: privacy, CSV schema, model cache, editing, batch control. No claim MetaStocker is objectively best; run same user-owned sample.

intent: Prepare separate Envato and Freepik metadata exports
brief: One illustrated gardening set. Distinguish the app's separate export choices from each platform's current required fields; no universal CSV guarantee.

intent: Use an optional personal OpenAI API key in MetaStocker
brief: Local mode needs no key. Optional personal API mode, developer account billing separate from ChatGPT, key not shared/publicly embedded, avoid exact prices/UI guesses.

intent: Write descriptive stock photo titles with before-and-after examples
brief: Three scenes: red umbrella on wet pavement, hands folding linen, seedlings by a window. Tighten vague titles without stuffing keywords.

intent: Choose the first ten Adobe Stock keywords for a difficult scene
brief: A close-up of hands repairing a bicycle wheel. Rank action, object, detail, setting; compare an equipment-heavy list with a subject-first list.

intent: Remove irrelevant AI-generated stock keywords
brief: A blue glass bottle on sand. Challenge ocean, perfume, recycling, luxury and brand guesses using a visible/known/unsupported table.

intent: Choose compound keywords without inventing long phrases
brief: Ice cream, copy space, coffee cup and yellow flower examples. Explain established concepts versus phrase spam; adapt to platform rules.

intent: Translate stock metadata into natural English
brief: Russian draft of a forest path scene; distinguish walk/path/footpath, preserve known location, avoid mixing language lists and literal translations.

intent: Describe copy space and composition accurately
brief: A potted plant placed at the right edge with clean wall to the left; when negative space is usable and why not every background qualifies.

intent: Add location keywords only when verified
brief: A generic European old street, a documented Krakow square and an unknown generated city. Explain what the photographer knows versus what AI guesses.

intent: Describe people accurately without guessing identity
brief: Hands preparing a meal, a self-described adult model and a distant group. Observable activity; demographic claims only from reliable model information.

intent: Keyword food photography without inventing ingredients
brief: Bowl of tomato soup with visible herbs. Don't assume vegan, organic, gluten-free or a named cuisine; hypothetical ingredient notes change valid metadata.

intent: Keyword isolated product photos for stock
brief: Unbranded reusable steel bottle on white. Material verified by shoot notes, isolated versus white backdrop, remove invisible sustainability promises.

intent: Describe abstract backgrounds without generic keyword spam
brief: Blue curved glass-like shapes with empty lower area. Visual texture, color, form, composition; don't assert real glass or 3D rendering unless known.

intent: Prepare metadata for vector illustrations
brief: A flat gardening icon collection; describe actual icons and style, distinguish editable vector deliverable from its raster preview and unsupported format claims.

intent: Write stock video metadata from the whole clip
brief: A camera pushes toward a steaming kettle while a hand enters. Sampled AI preview misses motion; watch start/middle/end, distinguish camera movement and subject action.

intent: Plan seasonal metadata without mislabeling assets
brief: A generic autumn leaf flat lay. Seasonal relevance versus adding Christmas/Halloween without cues; schedule preparation from observed needs, no revenue forecasts.

intent: Check an Adobe Stock CSV before importing
brief: Use one sample row with Filename,Title,Keywords,Category; category code must be verified; preview parsed cells; distinguish file export from successful portal import.

intent: Fix commas, quotes and UTF-8 in metadata CSV
brief: A title containing quotes and a comma plus accented place name. Show CSV escaping with doubled quotes and quoted keyword list, spreadsheet preview.

intent: Diagnose metadata CSV filename mismatch
brief: IMG_042.JPG versus img_042.jpg and a duplicated filename in separate folders. Reconcile basenames and extensions, protect original filenames and map one to one.

intent: Review generated metadata in a spreadsheet safely
brief: Columns for filename, title, keywords and reviewer note; avoid auto-formatting and formula execution from untrusted values. Work on copies, not originals.

intent: Check browser and computer readiness for local vision AI
brief: Compatibility checklist, secure HTTPS, WebGPU detected versus actual model success, disk for cache versus RAM/GPU memory, start with a single image.

intent: Test Gemma and Qwen for your own stock metadata workflow
brief: Same five images, same prompts and tag count, factual-error score and editing-time sheet; no unmeasured model superiority or fabricated benchmarks.

intent: Download and reuse a local AI model in the browser
brief: Explicit Download/Load; do not close tab mid-download; stable connection; browser/profile/origin isolation, cache may be evicted, don't promise offline.

intent: Unload or delete a browser AI model correctly
brief: Unload frees active worker memory while retaining downloaded files; delete cached model requires future download; device files elsewhere aren't deleted.

intent: Choose a sensible number of local AI threads
brief: One-thread baseline, test two, memory grows with separate worker model copies, diagnose slower parallel run and errors, no magic RAM rule.

intent: Troubleshoot WebGPU memory errors during keywording
brief: Unload unused models, reduce threads, close GPU-heavy applications and retry small file; distinguish download/network, incompatible GPU and bad output.

intent: Understand thinking mode in local metadata generation
brief: Reasoning versus final metadata, only final result exported, extra tokens cost latency, still check hallucinations, no chain-of-thought disclosure or accuracy guarantee.

intent: Understand what stays local during browser AI keywording
brief: Local photo inference versus model downloads, aggregate analytics and optional paid API path; public network diagram without misleading zero-network promise.

intent: Fix unreadable image, video and Illustrator previews
brief: A playable .mov with unsupported browser codec, an .ai without PDF-compatible preview, corrupted JPEG. Make supported previews carefully without changing original assets.

intent: Write useful batch context for AI keywording
brief: A known terracotta workshop in Porto plus a mixed travel batch. Context can supply facts but should not impose details on every file.

intent: Use shared extra tags without contaminating a batch
brief: A set of confirmed watercolor botanical illustrations and an unrelated photo. Shared style tags when true; first/end/random placement tradeoff and per-file audit.

intent: Run a final metadata quality check before stock upload
brief: A reusable two-pass review: image-to-text facts then text-to-platform format; inspect rejected words, filenames, language and portal readback.

intent: Audit an older stock portfolio without rewriting everything
brief: Small sampled group, record original title/tags/date, identify clear errors, change one justified group, compare future observations without causal claims.

intent: Build a reusable keyword vocabulary for a small portfolio
brief: Home cooking portfolio with subject/action/material/setting fields; vocabulary is suggestion library, not a list pasted onto every asset.

intent: Track metadata versions across exports and marketplaces
brief: Master file plus cropped variant, preserve mapping and reviewed exports with dates; no automatic upload status inferred from downloaded CSV.

intent: Understand stock marketplace search versus Google SEO
brief: A marketplace photo listing and photographer's own portfolio page use different signals; keyword CSV is not an HTML meta-keywords SEO trick.

intent: Improve image SEO on a photographer's own portfolio site
brief: A page about handmade ceramics with original photo, useful caption and concise alt text, crawlable image URL, fast dimensions, no tag-stuffed alt text.

intent: Create a sitemap for a photographer's own portfolio
brief: Five real canonical pages, exclude private drafts/filters; sitemap discovery versus indexing, honest lastmod and Search Console submission.

intent: Organize an English and Russian photography blog
brief: Two translated guide URLs with self-canonical and reciprocal hreflang, language switch that stays on article, no auto-redirect by IP.

intent: Measure useful outcomes from a stock photography blog
brief: Search impressions, clicks, article visits and generator use are separate; no permanent visitor ID means no unique-person attribution; compare like periods.

intent: Review metadata for drone footage
brief: Distinguish actual aerial viewpoint from guessed location or altitude.

intent: Describe time-lapse footage accurately
brief: Differentiate time-lapse, slow motion and ordinary video using verified production notes.

intent: Write metadata for slow-motion footage
brief: A pouring water clip; motion seen versus frame-rate specifications.

intent: Keyword macro photos without guessing species
brief: A close-up of an unknown insect on bark.

intent: Describe architectural stock photos
brief: A modern lobby; materials, interior view and verified building facts.

intent: Write useful stock texture metadata
brief: Cracked painted plaster; distinguish seamless deliverable from visual repetition.

intent: Keyword handmade craft scenes
brief: Hands weaving a basket; verified process versus guessed cultural origin.

intent: Describe fitness photos accurately
brief: Stretching on a mat; no medical benefit promises or guessed identity.

intent: Remove generic business keyword clutter
brief: A person packing parcels in a small workshop.

intent: Describe visible weather in stock imagery
brief: Wet pavement versus active rainfall; time and season from reliable notes.

intent: Keyword night photos with precision
brief: Street lamps and reflections; don't invent nightlife events.

intent: Describe pet photos without breed guesses
brief: Cat resting beside a window; breed requires confirmation.

intent: Keyword gardening photos accurately
brief: Hands repotting a seedling with verified plant information.

intent: Describe overhead flat lays
brief: Stationery arrangement; top view, copy space and actual objects.

intent: Explain transparent backgrounds in asset metadata
brief: PNG with real alpha versus white raster background.

intent: Keep edited variants distinguishable
brief: Three crops of a fruit still life, mapping titles and filenames.

intent: Review batch metadata using a contact sheet
brief: Spot outlier subjects before using shared context.

intent: Record shoot facts before AI keywording
brief: Location, materials, permissions kept separate from guessed visual facts.

intent: Repair rejected keywords from a specific review reason
brief: Read actual rejection, narrow repair, preserve original metadata.

intent: Check spelling without adding duplicates
brief: American/British spelling, established terms and platform language.

intent: Handle punctuation in stock titles
brief: Short clear descriptions, quotes and CSV representation.

intent: Shorten long stock titles without losing subject
brief: A 100-character draft edited to a concise descriptive sentence.

intent: Use mood keywords conservatively
brief: Empty bench at dusk: supported solitude versus invented sadness diagnosis.

intent: Choose color terms that help describe an asset
brief: Dominant versus incidental colors in a pattern.

intent: Describe seamless loops only after checking playback
brief: Animated gradient loop with end-to-start inspection.

intent: Review alpha-channel claims for motion graphics
brief: Actual exported alpha versus dark preview background.

intent: Separate pan, tilt, zoom and subject movement
brief: A bicycle crossing a static frame versus following camera.

intent: Select representative frames for metadata review
brief: Action only visible at the end of a clip.

intent: Find duplicate rows before metadata import
brief: Same filename twice with conflicting keywords.

intent: Find missing metadata fields before export
brief: Partial generation results and blank category cells.

intent: Diagnose semicolon versus comma CSV imports
brief: Locale changes spreadsheet interpretation; preserve quoted fields.

intent: Keep recoverable metadata export versions
brief: Original draft, reviewed CSV and portal confirmation note.

intent: Recover when a browser model cache disappears
brief: Browser cleanup and private profile behavior; redownload explicitly.

intent: Understand model downloads across browser profiles
brief: Same laptop, two profiles, independent caches.

intent: Cancel a batch and preserve reviewed results
brief: Distinguish cancellation from failed output; don't close unsaved work.

intent: Design a ten-file local AI trial
brief: Representative formats and difficult cases, record edits needed.

intent: Switch local models without wasting memory
brief: Unload old model, load selected, start single thread.

intent: Diagnose interrupted model downloads
brief: Network hosts, available storage and error messages without disabling security.

intent: Check valid-looking AI output for factual errors
brief: Well-formed metadata can still describe the wrong object.

intent: Plan a laptop keywording session
brief: Power supply, cooling, measured throughput, no hardware promises.

intent: Distinguish alt text, captions and stock keywords
brief: Same ceramic cup image in three different contexts.

intent: Choose canonical portfolio URLs
brief: Tracking parameters and duplicate routes do not need extra indexable pages.

intent: Link related portfolio guides usefully
brief: Specific next-step articles rather than repeated generic link blocks.

intent: Write clear page titles for a stock workflow blog
brief: Match actual question answered, avoid unsupported best claims.

intent: Write useful search descriptions
brief: Summarize concrete page value without clickbait or ranking promises.

intent: Read indexing reports without panic
brief: Submitted versus discovered versus indexed pages and waiting for data.

intent: Update old metadata guides honestly
brief: Verify changed steps and only change modified date when content changes.

intent: Plan a useful stock contributor content calendar
brief: Distinct reader questions instead of keyword permutations.

intent: Create original worked examples for tutorials
brief: Use owned assets or clearly described hypothetical scenes.

intent: Match a contributor guide to its search intent
brief: Troubleshooting CSV versus choosing a keyword tool; different deliverables.
